trickyParts: The volume template name changes from `tree` to `issue` for the controller's Sandbox too (PVC issue-legion-<project>-controller): a `controller: daemon` deployment's old controller Sandbox is refused by the census and cleared by the upgrade section's existing step 3

ensureSandbox no longer recreates a suspended Sandbox of another tree: it is JSON-patched to the new tree's label (uid-tested) so a re-admitted child keeps its volume and sessions; a Sandbox with no template (the tree-volume layout) is still replaced, as the census refuses that layout at boot anyway

A releasing IssueSuspend must wait until every stored claim of the issue is retired (store.IssueSuspension), since issue_close drops each claim's session and IssueHasSessions (retired claims included) decides whether workspace-init expects a clone: a stale session would make the next launch exit 3 as a lost volume
ProvisionBound shrank to workspace.FetchTimeout alone (no lock wait): the pre-hello bound at the defaults is 36 min, documented in Liveness rules
gVisor exposes no cgroup files: the in-pod checks are nproc == max(2, ceil(sum cpu limits)) and MemTotal within 3% of the summed memory limits; per-container values come from the API
